html: סַנְסַנָּה n.pr.loc. in S. Judah;—Jos 15:31, 𝔊 Σεθεννακ, A Σανσαννα, 𝔊L Σεενακ; prob. = חֲצַר סוּסָה 19:5, חֲצַר־סוּסִים 1 Ch 4:31; conj. on loc. (near Gaza), v. in Diad loc. BuhlGeogr. 163 and reff. (Simsum, NE. of Gaza, cp. by J. Schwarz Das heilig. Land (1852), 72 van d. VeldeMem, 346, is too far north).
